reference_sources: astro-templates/owl — sole source of layout, section order and component styling

brand_input.logo_note: Monochrome grey skyline mark with a serif wordmark. Supplies a neutral, not a hue.
brand_input.conclusion: No client brand hue and no client typeface could be traced to a real source, so the palette below was derived rather than extracted. The graphite primary echoes the logo mark; the accent is a single derived construction orange.

contrast_check.verdict: All 8 pairs PASS WCAG AA at the 4.5:1 threshold.
contrast_check.note: This accent is dark enough to carry WHITE button labels (5.18:1), so --color-on-accent is white rather than the owl default's near-black. As text on the dark primary bands the fill orange falls to 2.68:1, which is why accent-on-dark is a lighter tint of the same hue.

typography.rationale: No client typeface was detectable. Archivo is a grotesque with enough weight for the template's large uppercase headings; Inter carries the body. Loaded via the @import at the top of tokens.css, not via BaseLayout.

anti_patterns_enforced: generic stock photography — every project photo on this site is the client's own first-party work
fabricated ratings, review counts or testimonials
randomized section order — owl's fixed order is unchanged
